trips.route_note: Frequent Gautrain trains run from Johannesburg's Park, Rosebank or Sandton stations directly to Pretoria in about 40-50 minutes, with a short connecting ride or walk to the city centre sights.
quests: National Zoological Gardens of South Africa
trips.why: The Gautrain is fast, frequent and drops you right in Pretoria, beating the drive and far cheaper than a taxi.
know: Gautrain trains run frequently throughout the day from Park, Rosebank and Sandton stations
Allow extra time for the short connection from the station to the city centre sights
Spring (September-November) brings the jacarandas into purple bloom

problems: Cradle of Humankind: no Omio position, dropped
